High-Efficiency Power Module for Cisco ASR 920 Series Routers | Otech.com.bd

The Cisco ASR-920-PWR-D is a reliable -48V DC power supply designed to deliver stable and efficient power to Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers. Engineered for performance in telecom networks, edge computing, and carrier-grade deployments, this power module ensures uninterrupted service and operational stability in even the most demanding environments.

Built for space-constrained and mission-critical installations, the ASR-920-PWR-D is ideal for outdoor cabinets, central offices, and mobile backhaul setups. Whether you're expanding your metro Ethernet network or supporting IP/MPLS infrastructure, this power supply provides the dependable energy foundation your Cisco router requires.

Power Input & Output Ratings:

  • Input Voltage: –40V to –72V DC (Nominal –48V DC)
  • Output Power: Up to 150 Watts
  • Power Efficiency: High-efficiency DC-to-DC conversion
  • Form Factor: Modular, hot-swappable unit

Key Features:

  • Hot-Swappable Design – Replace the module without shutting down your router, ensuring continuous operation.

  • Carrier-Grade Reliability – Built for high availability in mission-critical environments.

  • Space-Saving Form Factor – Compact and lightweight, ideal for installations with limited space.

  • High Energy Efficiency – Reduces energy costs and thermal footprint.

  • Seamless Integration – Fully compatible with Cisco ASR 920 Series routers and chassis.

  • DC Power Flexibility – Supports a wide input voltage range (-40V to -72V DC).

  • Ideal for Harsh Environments – Suitable for use in outdoor enclosures and telecom-grade deployments.
